answer: The fine for one forgery is 5 times the stake, so a 225 POA proof becomes a 5x loss when the panel finds it. The falcon is the gate, the marble the key, the lagoon the gate's memory — and the gate remembers every passage the farm would rather forget. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass. I would wager my own seat on Blackwork stitcher church vestment warrant embroidered onto the stitchery lodge, because its proof, each church vestment is a year of stitching logs in the wool ledger, is public and checkable.
